BSGS-reference-cost.baseline_conditions: A comparison needs the same public E,G,Q,r, target distribution, complete recovery/success policy, cold/warm setup policy, memory allowance, stopping/censoring rule, backend and primitive definitions. BSGS host costs are not automatically commensurable with worker primitive vectors. Full-orbit label construction and other host audit work stay separate from the BSGS solver path. A typical square-root table size is an algorithmic parameter, not a measured cost or byte count here.
BSGS-reference-cost.formula: For one curve and 64 targets, C_BSGS=S_table + sum_(u=1..64)(C_online,u+C_verify,u), with table memory once. Cold first-target cost includes S_table; warm target cost conditions on an already-paid retained table. Amortized setup is S_table/64 only for that actual reuse scope.

cold-start-and-reuse.allocation: A curve is constructed once when reused; prepared setup is once per actual (curve,arm) cache lifetime. The design names 216 prepared setups: 24 calibration curves*8 arms +24 confirmation curves*1 arm. These are not 216 new curves. If a cache is physically rebuilt, each rebuild is paid.
cold-start-and-reuse.amortization: For n distinct targets genuinely sharing G_c and S_ca, allocate (G_c+S_ca)/n per target, disclose n and retain the cold total. A per-recovered-target allocation uses the actual number recovered and differs from per-target amortization. No setup charge is removed from the batch.
cold-start-and-reuse.formula: C_operational(batch)=sum_c G_c + sum_(c,a actually used) S_ca + sum_(c,u actually prepared) T_cu + sum_(c,u,j actually executed) A_cuj, componentwise. C_study=C_operational(all executed evaluator/control/calibration work)+H, with each physical event once.
cold-start-and-reuse.notation: G_c=curve generation/certification including rejected proposals; S_ca=prepared base/circuit setup for curve c and arm a; T_cu=one-time target preparation; A_cuj=complete physical attempt work; H=explicit host/control/study overhead.
cold-start-and-reuse.study_vs_solver: Both paired evaluators, calibration arms, six-cell enumeration, host truth/orbit construction, conditional references, transport and report work are part of the executed study. A hypothetical operational solver may choose one specified method/cell, but its complete cost must be derived separately; excluding study-only work cannot erase physical study cost or make required operational preparation free.

complete-attempt-and-empty-list.M: M counts distinct legal nonzero candidate scalars actually eligible for the matched-M reference; M<=min(W,r-1). Illegal words, duplicate scalars and zero candidates can incur work without contributing to M.
complete-attempt-and-empty-list.M0: M=0 does not imply zero attempt cost. Setup, target generation/blinding, RNG and rejection, all performed queries, reductions, enumeration and any zero-candidate/public checks remain paid. A cap or early invalid branch pays work already performed; unperformed checks are not fabricated.
complete-attempt-and-empty-list.completion_policy: Frozen enumeration continues through all words after a hit; all actual work must be counted. If a separate solver stops on first verified success, that is a different complete-attempt cost law requiring its own matched comparison.
complete-attempt-and-empty-list.conversion: P=[a]G is prepared at the correct reuse scope; Qprime=[b]Q is paid per blinding; a,b must be nonzero units mod r. For a candidate k, x=a*b^-1*k mod r. Pay inversion/conversion and [k]P=Qprime plus [x]G=Q under the declared candidate-check schedule.
complete-attempt-and-empty-list.formula: A_cuj = target blinding and nonzero-b generation/rejection + [b]Q + method query generation/evaluation/reduction + decoder word generation/filter/deduplication + scalar conversions + both public checks actually executed + attempt-local memory and termination overhead.
complete-attempt-and-empty-list.list_bound: For L bits with e erased positions and at most t errors among defined positions, W(L,t,e)=2^e*sum_(j=0..min(t,L-e)) binom(L-e,j), provided e is within the cell cap. Every enumerated word and all rejection/deduplication work remain paid. With frozen L<=17,t<=2,e<=2, W<=4*(1+15+105)=484.

conditional-uniform-reference.cost: C_reference=C_M_determination + generation/PRNG rejection + uniqueness storage/checks + m public scalar checks + verification overhead. Report standalone guess/check work separately from candidate-derived M-determination and conditioning. M-determination includes the list and candidate legality work; it is not a free oracle.
conditional-uniform-reference.law: Given actual M, sample m=min(M,r-1) distinct nonzero scalars without replacement; conditional hit probability is m/(r-1). At M=0 the guess set is empty. Saturation m=r-1 gives conditional certainty while retaining its full cost.
conditional-uniform-reference.scope: The 73728 planned calls are nested diagnostics sharing target/trace/cell information. They are not a standalone solver, an iid null ensemble or an attack baseline with free M. No P1/3 baseline is inferred.

assumptions: fresh complete restarts with identical conditional law
stop rule and verification policy specified
q derived or estimable under that exact law
failed attempts and cap/error work retained
no substitution of dependent cell rows or heterogeneous curves for iid restarts
descriptive-cost-and-restart-formula.conditional_expected: For fixed curve/function/target policy and iid complete restart pairs (C_i,S_i), with q=P(S_i=1)>0 and finite E[C_i], expected work until first success is E[C_i]/q. Within an attempt C_i and S_i may be dependent. Derivation: E[sum_(i<=N) C_i]=sum_i E[C_i]P(N>=i)=E[C_i]*sum_i(1-q)^(i-1)=E[C_i]/q.
descriptive-cost-and-restart-formula.descriptive: For observed cost vector C and V distinct targets independently verified recovered, C/V is descriptive work per unique target recovered if V>0; null/undefined if V=0. Also report verified attempt events, retained unique targets, attempts per target and censoring separately. Repeated hits on one target cannot increase V.
descriptive-cost-and-restart-formula.setup_placement: If curve setup and target prep are retained across retries, C_expected=G_c+S_ca+T_cu+E[C_complete_online]/q. Any component physically repeated per restart belongs inside C_complete_online. Rebuilding setup per restart instead yields E[C_complete_cold]/q.
descriptive-cost-and-restart-formula.zero_and_censoring: Zero observed recoveries do not establish mathematical q=0. Failed, capped or right-censored runs do not supply complete restart observations; cost per success is undefined at zero successes and E[C]/q is not identified from incomplete work. A fixed-curve zero-event bound needs its own complete-event independence and family assumptions. Shared curves, targets, blindings and cells do not provide an iid population sample.

dimensioned-cost-vector.aggregation: Add only disjoint primitive event counts with identical dimensions. Scalar-multiplication totals and their nested group/field primitives are alternative views, not summands. A missing counter is unknown, never zero. No worker/host conversion factor or native timing qualification is supplied by a bookkeeping identity.
dimensioned-cost-vector.definition: An event has a unique physical owner, backend, primitive unit, scope and amount. Cost is a vector indexed by (backend, primitive unit, scope), not a scalar sum of heterogeneous fields.
dimensions: worker scalar multiplication invocations and steps separately
host independent group and field operations separately
PRNG invocations, draws, rejected draws and bytes separately
curve proposals, point proposals and certification work
currency or energy only if measured
dimensioned-cost-vector.memory: Peak live memory is max_t of simultaneous live entries/bytes; a reused table contributes once to that maximum. Allocation counts, retained bytes and RSS are distinct. Entry counts do not imply bytes without representation sizes.

physical-versus-logical-populations.definition: Original and incremental evaluators are separate physical predicate streams on paired inputs. Six logical decoder cells reuse one retained incremental trace and do not create six predicate streams, six independent curves or six physical VM invocations.
physical-versus-logical-populations.export: Two method export rows describe one parent RUN/VM. Their own confirmation counters exclude shared setup/calibration/six-cell/reference streams; complete study cost requires joining those auxiliary streams exactly once.
physical-versus-logical-populations.formula: Study trace work = C_original_queries + C_incremental_queries + sum_six_cells C_cell_decode/conversion/check + common physical preparation once. A cell view may disclose its shared trace work, but summing such disclosures must deduplicate by physical trace owner.
physical-versus-logical-populations.repeated_generation: The frozen calibration namespace can name shared logical points/starts across eight arms while physically regenerating them. Every actual regeneration and rejection remains charged, even when coordinates agree.

Compare independently aggregated vectors against retained producer summaries without treating schema/hash/checker success as metric recomputation; preserve the smallest reproducible discrepancy.

Run the unchanged fixed bookkeeping argument on known-false mutations; retain executed code bytes/hash before and after commands, actual argv/return code/timestamps/stdout, and original executed source even if report code later changes.

Produce compact report/diagram/PDF, inspect every actual PDF page, and attest exact actual seal/release/read chronology. Joint verdict only J-cost: holds, breaks or inconclusive within inspected coverage.
post-release-check-plan.inventory: After the actual hash-bound release plus explicit root ACK, enumerate only the finite phase2 allowlisted source/data roots. Use hydrated regular files even when default rg ignores them; retain exact relative path, hash, byte count, row count and missing/extra cases. Never read siblings or producer functions through imports/calls.
post-release-check-plan.verdict_rule: No verdict now. Later holds requires agreement in bounded instrumented scope and passing controls; breaks requires a reproducible retained-source contradiction or accepted known-false control; absent counters/witnesses, unsupported branches, unresolved mismatch or chronology contamination yield inconclusive at the affected scope.

release_requirement: Stop after seal. Root commits and pushes exact derivation/seal, then publishes hash-bound release and gives explicit ACK. Elapsed time or generic continuation is insufficient.
